most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Legionnaires disease (Legionella infection) with prominent GI symptoms; the main alternatives are an invasive enteric infection (Salmonella) or tick-borne ehrlichiosis despite the denied tick bite
one_line_reason: Fever with profuse diarrhea, confusion, worsening hyponatremia, AST-predominant transaminitis and a low-normal WBC in an older man with diabetes and COPD is the classic Legionella extrapulmonary pattern. Melena and missing chest imaging leave room for enteric Salmonella or typhoid.
